what: SPEED-RT surface stage's timing sets: SURF-v2's six distances (20 chunks of 10,000 shots each, pods S-low d = 7, 9, 11 and S-high d = 13, 15, 17) and the Grace fit's twelve reference sets (one chunk of 10,000 shots per (d, p), NVIDIA's legacy circuits, timed by the CPU worker on winserver). Drawn once on Alpine by speed_rt/draw.py after the stage's beacon; every chunk is Stim 1.16.0's detector sampler on the set's circuit at the chunk's seed (speed_rt/sets.py: TAG 'convlines speed-rt <set>'). The stage's beacon record names this file (sets_file).
